body:
Use this issue to track Sepo setup for this repository.

The latest setup status is maintained in the comment below.

comments.body:
<!-- sepo-agent-installation-bootstrap -->
The Sepo GitHub App was installed on **CodeShaping/annotate-edit**, but automatic onboarding did not start.

- **Repository:** `CodeShaping/annotate-edit`
- **Default branch:** `main`
- **Reason:** .github/workflows/agent-onboarding.yml not found on main

**Next steps:**

1. Confirm `.github/workflows/agent-onboarding.yml` exists on `main`.
2. Enable GitHub Actions for this repository.
3. Confirm App permissions: `Contents: read`, `Actions: write`, `Issues: write`.
4. Configure `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` as repository secrets.
5. Manually run **Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup** via Actions.

<!-- sepo-agent-onboarding-check -->
## Sepo setup status

### Current status

- [x] GitHub App/auth: resolved via `oidc_broker`
- [x] Model credentials: `OPENAI_API_KEY` configured
  - Agent provider: `codex` (OPENAI_API_KEY is configured)
- [ ] Memory: not initialized
  - Run **[Actions > Agent / Memory / Initialization](https://github.com/CodeShaping/annotate-edit/actions/workflows/agent-memory-bootstrap.yml)**.
- [ ] Rubrics: not initialized
  - Optional: run **[Actions > Agent / Rubrics / Initialization](https://github.com/CodeShaping/annotate-edit/actions/workflows/agent-rubrics-initialization.yml)**.

### Remaining setup

- [ ] Run [Agent / Memory / Initialization](https://github.com/CodeShaping/annotate-edit/actions/workflows/agent-memory-bootstrap.yml) to initialize memory branch `agent/memory`.
- [ ] Optional: run [Agent / Rubrics / Initialization](https://github.com/CodeShaping/annotate-edit/actions/workflows/agent-rubrics-initialization.yml) to initialize rubrics branch `agent/rubrics`.

### Test Sepo

After setup, try:

```md
@sepo-agent /answer Is Sepo configured correctly in this repository?
```

Try implementation:

```md
@sepo-agent /implement Create a small README update that verifies the agent can open a PR.
```

On an open pull request:

```md
@sepo-agent /review
```
